_header.description: Permanent regression proof for the rule_based encoder port. Frozen output of both the ORIGINAL (external/rule-based-reference) and PORTED (evodevo.encoders.rule_based) developmental-rule interpreters, generated while both were present on disk and verified identical (modulo the documented SOFT/HARD fix -- see docs/decisions.md). This fixture is permanent and CANNOT be regenerated once external/rule-based-reference/ is removed -- if the ported code's behavior ever drifts from these values, that is a real regression.
_header.note: genomes are stored via RuleBasedEncoder.serialize_genome(); expected_body arrays already reflect the port's corrected RIGID=1/SOFT=2 convention (matching evodevo.core.materials), not the original's inverted SOFT=1/HARD=2 codes.
